completion_rate: SELECT toStartOfDay(started_at) AS day, 100.0 * countIf(isNotNull(completed_at) AND completed_at >= started_at) / count() AS completion_rate FROM (SELECT toString(properties.match_id) AS match_id, min(if(event = 'match_started', timestamp, NULL)) AS started_at, min(if(event = 'match_completed', timestamp, NULL)) AS completed_at FROM events WHERE event IN ('match_started','match_completed') AND properties.environment = 'production' AND properties.game_mode = 'multiplayer' AND isNotNull(properties.match_id) AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY match_id) WHERE isNotNull(started_at) AND started_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT 100
matches_per_active_player: SELECT day, sum(if(active = 1, completed_matches, 0)) / nullIf(countIf(active = 1), 0) AS matches_per_active_player FROM (SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS day, person_id, max(if(event IN ('app_opened','shot_selected'), 1, 0)) AS active, countDistinctIf(toString(properties.match_id), event = 'match_completed' AND isNotNull(properties.match_id)) AS completed_matches FROM events WHERE event IN ('app_opened','shot_selected','match_completed') AND properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day, person_id) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT 100
rematch_pipeline:
SELECT
  countDistinct(match_key) AS original_matches_completed,
  countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at) AS reached_requested,
  countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at AND accepted_at >= requested_at) AS reached_accepted,
  countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at AND accepted_at >= requested_at AND started_at >= accepted_at) AS reached_started,
  countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at AND accepted_at >= requested_at AND started_at >= accepted_at AND rematch_completed_at >= started_at) AS reached_rematch_completed,
  round(
    100.0 * countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at) / nullIf(countDistinct(match_key), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_to_requested,
  round(
    100.0 * countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at AND accepted_at >= requested_at) / nullIf(countDistinct(match_key), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_to_accepted,
  round(
    100.0 * countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at AND accepted_at >= requested_at AND started_at >= accepted_at) / nullIf(countDistinct(match_key), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_to_started,
  round(
    100.0 * countDistinctIf(match_key, requested_at >= completed_at AND accepted_at >= requested_at AND started_at >= accepted_at AND rematch_completed_at >= started_at) / nullIf(countDistinct(match_key), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_to_rematch_completed
FROM (
  SELECT
    match_key,
    min(if(stage = 'completed', ts, NULL)) AS completed_at,
    min(if(stage = 'requested', ts, NULL)) AS requested_at,
    min(if(stage = 'accepted', ts, NULL)) AS accepted_at,
    min(if(stage = 'started', ts, NULL)) AS started_at,
    min(if(stage = 'rematch_completed', ts, NULL)) AS rematch_completed_at
  FROM (
    SELECT toString(properties.match_id) AS match_key, coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0) AS ts, 'completed' AS stage
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'match_completed'
      AND properties.environment = 'production'
      AND properties.game_mode = 'multiplayer'
      AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY

    UNION ALL

    SELECT toString(properties.original_match_id) AS match_key, coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0) AS ts, 'requested' AS stage
    FROM events
    WHERE event IN ('rematch_manual_requested', 'rematch_auto_requested')
      AND properties.environment = 'production'
      AND isNotNull(properties.original_match_id)
      AND toString(properties.original_match_id) != ''
      AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY

    UNION ALL

    SELECT toString(properties.original_match_id) AS match_key, coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0) AS ts, 'accepted' AS stage
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'rematch_accepted'
      AND properties.environment = 'production'
      AND isNotNull(properties.original_match_id)
      AND toString(properties.original_match_id) != ''
      AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY

    UNION ALL

    SELECT toString(properties.original_match_id) AS match_key, coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0) AS ts, 'started' AS stage
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'rematch_started'
      AND properties.environment = 'production'
      AND isNotNull(properties.original_match_id)
      AND toString(properties.original_match_id) != ''
      AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY

    UNION ALL

    SELECT toString(properties.original_match_id) AS match_key, coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0) AS ts, 'rematch_completed' AS stage
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'rematch_completed'
      AND properties.environment = 'production'
      AND isNotNull(properties.original_match_id)
      AND toString(properties.original_match_id) != ''
      AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  )
  WHERE isNotNull(match_key) AND match_key != ''
  GROUP BY match_key
)
WHERE isNotNull(completed_at)
LIMIT 100
invite_pipeline:
SELECT
    countDistinct(invite_id) AS invites_sent,
    countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at, invite_id, NULL)) AS invites_opened,
    countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at AND accepted_at >= opened_at, invite_id, NULL)) AS invites_accepted,
    countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at AND accepted_at >= opened_at AND activated_at >= accepted_at, invite_id, NULL)) AS invitees_activated,
    countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at AND accepted_at >= opened_at AND activated_at >= accepted_at AND first_match_at >= activated_at, invite_id, NULL)) AS invitees_first_match_completed,
    round(
        100.0 * countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at, invite_id, NULL))
        / nullIf(countDistinct(invite_id), 0),
        1
    ) AS open_rate_pct,
    round(
        100.0 * countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at AND accepted_at >= opened_at, invite_id, NULL))
        / nullIf(countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at, invite_id, NULL)), 0),
        1
    ) AS accept_rate_pct,
    round(
        100.0 * countDistinct(if(opened_at >= sent_at AND accepted_at >= opened_at AND activated_at >= accepted_at AND first_match_at >= activated_at, invite_id, NULL))
        / nullIf(countDistinct(invite_id), 0),
        1
    ) AS invite_to_first_match_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        properties.invite_id AS invite_id,
        min(if(event = 'invite_sent', coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0), NULL)) AS sent_at,
        min(if(event = 'invite_opened', coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0), NULL)) AS opened_at,
        min(if(event = 'invite_accepted', coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0), NULL)) AS accepted_at,
        min(if(event = 'invited_player_activated', coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0), NULL)) AS activated_at,
        min(if(event = 'invited_player_first_match_completed', coalesce(toFloat(properties.domain_timestamp_ms), toFloat(toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)) * 1000.0), NULL)) AS first_match_at
    FROM events
    WHERE
        timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
        AND event IN (
            'invite_sent',
            'invite_opened',
            'invite_accepted',
            'invited_player_activated',
            'invited_player_first_match_completed'
        )
        AND properties.environment = 'production'
        AND isNotNull(properties.invite_id)
    GROUP BY invite_id
)
WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL
daily_active_players: SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS day, countDistinct(person_id) AS daily_active_players FROM events WHERE event IN ('app_opened','shot_selected') AND properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC LIMIT 100
weekly_active_players: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) AS week, countDistinct(person_id) AS weekly_active_players FROM events WHERE event IN ('app_opened','shot_selected') AND properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY week ORDER BY week ASC LIMIT 100
monthly_active_players: SELECT toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS month, countDistinct(person_id) AS monthly_active_players FROM events WHERE event IN ('app_opened','shot_selected') AND properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 365 DAY GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 100
